proof.note: Private test network behind the SeedSigner simulator at https://bitsaga.be/seedsigner-simulator/ . Not publicly joinable. The coins are not real bitcoin and are worth nothing. Background: https://bitsaga.be/signet
proof.genesis_hash_note: Shared with the public signet and with every other custom signet: Bitcoin Core hard-codes one genesis block for all of them. It tells you this is a signet, not which signet. The challenge, and the network magic derived from it, are what make this chain a separate network.
proof.proves: That this transaction, byte for byte, is in the block whose header is here, and that the header carries a signature valid against the signet challenge above. Both can be rechecked from these bytes without trusting this answer.
proof.does_not_prove: Nothing about value: the coins on this chain are not bitcoin, cannot be sold or sent anywhere else, and are worth nothing. It also does not prove this block is on a chain anyone else can see. We run the only node and we hold the signing key, so checking that would need a second, independent node, and this network deliberately has none.
